reason: The approximately 305.119 A^3 index-5 cell and a rocksalt-like average framework are well supported by the parent reflections, diagnostic splitting, plausible density, and sixfold chloride coordination. Exact recovery of the submitted realization is not sufficiently established, however. The comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable, and the trajectory profiled only one imposed ideal-coordinate ordered-rocksalt model after ranking index-5 superlattices mainly by reflection positions. It did not instantiate and comparably test coordinate-relaxed C2/m variants, the known scientifically plausible cubic K/Na-disordered rocksalt description, or other order/supercell realizations. The weak superstructure features do not by themselves establish the exact rational coordinates and K/Na ordering, and the CIF is conservatively declared P1 even though its metric and coordinates are detected as C2/m. Thus the cell and average framework are credible, but symmetry, coordinates, and elemental ordering remain underdetermined enough to warrant another attempt.
